page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top: "18" at the left, "De Episcopatu" in the centre, and a quaestio mark with "II." at the right. Below the running head, the body text runs continuously, followed by a centred heading (QUÆST· II. with its title) and then a further paragraph. No margin notes. The paragraph ends at the bottom with the hyphenated word "Pasto-".

page.notes: The Greek word in the sixth line is uncertain: printed as "τὸ xgivómεvov" in a poor scan, read as τὸ κρινόμενον[?]. The page number "18" and the running head are printed normally. The mark at the right of the running head is a quaestio sign, read as "Q II." with a symbol that may be a ligature; it was not included in the running head. The "I" opening the paragraph is a large initial, joined to "ta" as "Ita". The number "1 8." in the citation is printed with a space, copied as printed. Ligature-like forms in "Pontificios" and "statuit" are read as printed. Digitiser's stamp at the bottom right is excluded.
